tools.description: Search the web using the SearXNG meta-search engine.This is a common search tool. Use it when no other search tools are available.

num_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10)

tools.name: searxng

tools.description: Search web information, returns results including web page title, web page URL, web page summary, website name, website icon, etc.

content_size.description: Control the number of words in the web page summary; default value is balance - balanced : suitable for most queries. - detail: more comprehensive answers.

domain.description: Used to limit the scope of search results, only return content from specified whitelist domains, such as: www.example.com.

query.description: Content to be searched. Characters less than 70 are recommended.

range.description: Search for web pages within a specified time range.

tools.name: zai

tools.description: Semantic web search (Exa). Describe the page you want rather than listing keywords; Exa returns clean content highlights from the top results. Verified reachable from this machine.

numResults.description: Number of search results to return (default: 10).

objective.description: What you are trying to find out; Exa uses it to rank results.

query.description: Natural language search query. Should be a semantically rich description of the ideal page, not just keywords. Optionally include category:<type> (company, people) to focus results — e.g. 'category:people John Doe software engineer'.

tools.name: exa

tools.description: Web search on the Chinese web. It carries site authority grading (auth_level) and can return full page text (need_content).

auth_level.description: 权威等级过滤，0 为默认，1 为非常权威
auth_level.title: Authlevel

count.description: 返回条数；默认为 10 条,最多 50 条
count.title: Count

sites.description: 仅搜索指定站点，以 | 分隔，最多 20 个
sites.title: Sites

time_range.description: 搜索时间范围，OneDay/OneWeek/OneMonth/OneYear 或日期区间
time_range.title: Timerange

tools.name: doubao

tools.description: 腾讯元宝联网搜索。适合中文官网和中文文档定位，与豆包中文媒体搜索互补；英文官方技术资料优先现有智谱。默认网页模式0，按需使用原生site/freshness筛选；site传完整主机域名，不能假定含全部子域。返回Response.Pages内JSON字符串，passage和content可截断，不是全文抓取；垂直卡片须核验信源和更新时间。当前每月2000次免费为用户确认权益，未查询剩余。

count.description: 返回条数档位10/20/30/40/50，字符串；省略按上游默认10，混合模式可额外加入垂直卡片。

freshness.description: 搜索时效范围。示例：d[N]表示搜索最近N天，N取值1-30整数；m[N]表示搜索最近N月，N取值1-12整数；y[N]表示搜索最近N年，N取值1-5整数。例如，2026.6.10分别传参d7/m3/y1进行搜索，则搜索结果的时间范围分别为“2026.6.10-2026.6.4”/“2026.6.10-2026.4.1”/“2026”，以此类推。

industry.description: 垂直领域搜索。示例：gov/news/acad/finance，分别对应党政机关、权威媒体、学术（英文）、金融。

mode.description: 返回结果类型，不传默认为0。取值：0，公开网页信源结果；1，优质权威垂直信源结果（如天气、金价、股价等实时垂直权威信息）；2，混合结果。

query.description: 搜索词/查询词。必填，UTF-8 字节数不超过 1500（约 500 个中英文字符）。示例：今天北京的天气

site.description: 严格域名，如zsb.ustc.edu.cn；不传URL或路径，不保证自动含子域。

tools.name: yuanbao
